_note: Authored ECHO lines (owner: C). Shown when the backend is offline, slow, rate-limited, or invalid. Max 180 characters each. Lines rotate in order. These are labeled OFFLINE in the HUD; never present them as live model output.
run_start: ECHO online. Mostly. We are falling toward a black hole, so let's not dawdle. Terminal first.
Hello again. The ship is tumbling and so am I. Start the evacuation at the terminal.
evacuation_started: Evacuation started. Six minutes, give or take my rounding errors. Engineering is to the right.
Clock is running. Engineering next. Hold SPACE when the floor starts arguing with you.
power_restored: Power restored. The cargo sled is awake, unlike most of my subroutines.
Lights on. Cargo is open. The next DOWN surge should do the heavy lifting for us.
puzzle_solved: Navigation recovered. I am choosing to interpret that as optimism.
The sled hit the plate. Gravity did the work and we take the credit. Grab the core.
core_collected: Core secured. It is warm, which I'm told is a good sign. Pod bay is open.
You have the core. I have hope. One of those is load-bearing.
clamp_released: Clamp released. The pod is free and so, almost, are you.
Pod is unclamped. Please board before it develops ambitions of its own.
launch: Course set for Earth. Please remember the stars from somewhere safer.
debris_hit_repeat: Your suit has filed another complaint. Try the magnetic boots.
That wreckage is winning. Brace with SPACE when the arrow turns red.
Debris to the face costs us ten seconds. I'm keeping a tally. Please stop.
boots_frequent: You and those boots. A lasting relationship.
Excellent bracing technique. The floor thanks you. I thank you. The black hole does not.
low_time: Under a minute. I would run, if I had legs.
Sixty seconds. I recommend panic, but efficiently.
help: Follow the objective at the top of your screen. I believe in you. Statistically.
help_start_evacuation: The terminal near the top of the cockpit. Walk up to it and press E.
help_restore_power: Engineering power console, lower half of the room. Hold SPACE if the pull drags you off course.
help_open_compartment: Let gravity work. When the arrow says DOWN, the sled slides onto the plate. Stay out of the red debris lanes.
help_collect_core: Compartment's open, top-right of Cargo. The glowing thing is the core. Please don't lick it.
help_release_clamp: Clamp console, top of the Pod Bay. Press E and the pod is ours.
help_board_pod: The pod. Get in the pod. Press E. I'll handle the dramatic music.
